recipe.variant: H3-Base Ref2VA int8, 20 steps: continues an existing clip (its first 22 frames + soundtrack anchored at frame 0 by one Add Guide)
recipe.from_template: video_minimax_h3_multiframe_reference — its graph with a single Add Guide, wired as the template's own note prescribes for continuation ('feed the first 22 frames of an existing video plus its audio into one Add Guide at frame_idx 0 to continue both streams'); Comfy-Org ships no separate continuation graph (video_minimax_h3_i2v_continuation is a plain i2v)
recipe.defaults_note: 864x480x124, 20 steps; the first 1.0 s of the source clip (24 frames at 24 fps, cropped by Add Guide to the 22-frame grid) and its audio are anchored at frame 0; the generated clip re-renders that second and continues it.

vram_evidence.note: same 20.97 GB build as the fl2va recipes; reference tokens 'ride along every sampling step' so expect more than t2v at the same canvas

notes: length is frames at 24 fps on the 17k+5 grid: 5, 22, ..., 107 (~4.5 s), 124 (5.17 s), 141, ..., 362 (15.1 s). The template derives it from seconds as max(5, round(s*24)) + (5 - (max(5, round(s*24)) % 17)) % 17; this recipe inlines 124.

Canvas: 768 px short edge, capped at the 768x1344 pixel area, multiples of 32. Template default 0.4 MP 16:9 = 864x480 (fast preview); 0.98 MP = 1344x768 is the official 768p and holds faces/detail; never 1.0 MP (1376x768 is above the cap).
No negative prompt, no CFG: the checkpoints are CFG-distilled and the graph uses BasicGuider. Write bans as positives.

Add Guide crops an image batch DOWN to the 17k+5 clip lengths (5, 22, 39 ...), so the slice is 1.0 s (24 frames -> 22); a slice shorter than 22 frames would collapse to 5. The source must be 24 fps (an H3 output is). Audio is 'cropped to the video's remaining duration' from frame 0.

To extend clip A with this recipe: set source_start_s to A's duration minus 1.0 so the slice is A's last second, generate, then drop the first 22 frames of the result when joining A + B. Set the canvas to A's size (multiples of 32).

Guides condition, they do not seed the latent (docs: 'not video-to-video'); for restyling use a reference video on ref_videos, for partial regeneration the mask route. Optional: also connect the source clip to ref_videos.ref_video_0 (+ ref_video_audios.ref_video_audio_0) for identity/voice lock as <Video 1>/<Audio 1> at the cost of reference tokens on every step.
